implementation_summary: Added the audit barrel (crawl, analysis, ai, documents, store, pipeline, phone-layout; preview omitted) and the single export line in the core barrel. Added a contract test for entry-point reachability, identity of group exports in @qa/core, and a source scan for direct fetch and Playwright request APIs.
risks: The test allow-lists packages/core/src/audit/store/select-backend.ts, which uses globalThis.fetch as the injectable default for the Cloud Storage backend. A reviewer should confirm that is acceptable, or ask BE-601's owner to inject fetch from outside.
audit/documents re-exports Playwright and node:zlib code through the core barrel, so the wizard must never import it. This was already noted by BE-506.
phone-layout is exported through the barrel because the task asked for it, although BE-708's handoff said it was not in the barrel.
handoff: BE-190: runner routes can import every audit entry point from @qa/core. The audit barrel needs no further edits. If a later group adds an export whose name clashes with an existing one, the identity test and the TS build will flag it; fix it with the owning group.
